hero.statement: Software built for how your business actually works.
hero.support: I design and build custom platforms — online stores, internal tools, interactive products — for companies that need more than a template.

approach.title: How I work.
paragraphs: I start with the problem, not the stack. Most projects arrive already described as a piece of software — a store, a dashboard, an app. The useful conversation is the one underneath: what the business actually does every day, where the current process breaks, and what would have to be true for a new one to hold.

I build for the person at the other end. A tool three people live in every day has different requirements from a storefront a thousand strangers see once, and a game used by someone with Alzheimer's has different requirements from both. Deciding who it is for, first, is what keeps every later decision honest.

I would rather ship something small that fits than something large that almost does. Scope grows on its own; the parts that make software feel considered — the empty states, the wording, what happens when something goes wrong — are the first things cut when it does. So I keep the surface narrow and finish it properly.

capabilities.title: What you can hire me to build.

groups.name: Web platforms and e-commerce
groups.description: Storefronts, checkout, and the administration behind them — built around how you actually sell rather than around a theme's assumptions.

groups.name: Internal tools and intranets
groups.description: The unglamorous software a team lives inside: inventory, orders, roles and permissions, reporting. Usually the highest-leverage thing a business can build.

groups.name: Interactive and games
groups.description: Unity work for products where the interaction is the point — training, simulation, accessibility, play.

capabilities.note: Strongest on the web platform side, where most of my work has been. If you need something adjacent, ask — I would rather tell you it is not my ground than learn it on your budget.

studio.title: For work that needs a team.
studio.body: Alongside my own projects I build with Atomic Software Studio, which takes on intelligent and automated systems for businesses. When a project needs more hands than mine, it goes there.

contact.title: Tell me what you're building.
contact.body: If you have a process that does not fit off-the-shelf software, or a product that needs building properly, write to me. Tell me what the problem is and roughly when you need it, and I will tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it.
